dishes.pairing_mechanics: Room-temperature or cool (not ice-cold) water after hot broth balances salt and fat; in winter the message is steady hydration rather than a heat-relief shock
dishes.physiological_impact: Warming, salty and fatty broth; common in cold months and as a first dish at iftar or gatherings
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Rich lamb broth with large pieces of meat on the bone, potatoes, carrots, onion, chickpeas, tomato; fatty surface, herbs (dill, coriander), black pepper

dishes.pairing_mechanics: Ice-cold still water (4-6°C) against hot fat creates a strong temperature contrast that rinses the fatty film from the tongue and resets taste between spoonfuls; clean neutral taste does not compete with cumin and carrot sweetness; sipping replaces sugary sodas at the table
dishes.physiological_impact: Very high fat load coats the palate and slows gastric emptying; salt and cumin raise thirst; post-meal heaviness and drowsiness, especially after midday wedding or Thursday osh
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Rice cooked in rendered lamb tail fat (dumba) and cottonseed oil, lamb or beef, yellow and red carrots, whole garlic heads, chickpeas, cumin (zira), barberry; served from a large kazan

dishes.pairing_mechanics: A cold sip after each bite gives a refreshing contrast to the hot, greasy pastry and clears crumbs and fat from the palate; the on-the-go 0.5L format matches the street-snack moment
dishes.physiological_impact: Buttery dough plus fatty filling is dense and dry; hot juice and flaky crumbs leave the mouth greasy and thirsty; common grab-and-go breakfast or snack
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Layered puff dough brushed with tallow or butter, filled with minced lamb, onion and lamb tail fat, black pepper and cumin; baked on tandir walls, sesame on top

framework.name: COCA_COLA_EMOTIONAL

do: Use family words: oila, dasturxon, mehmon, ona, buvi
End with a shared toast of water
voiceover.music: Soft dutar / rubab motif or piano; no drops
voiceover.voice: Mature, calm male or female voice; conversational, like a relative speaking at the table

ru: Самые тёплые моменты - с самой чистой водой.
uz: Eng qadrli lahzalar - eng toza suv bilan.

framework.visual_style: Golden-hour or warm tungsten light (2700-3200K), soft diffusion, slow dolly-ins and gentle handheld, 24fps, shallow depth of field on hands and faces, long takes (3-5s), steam and candle/fire glow, product appears late (after second 6) and is poured for someone else, never for oneself
framework.neural_target: Hippocampus & Prefrontal Cortex (episodic memory, social-reward valuation)
framework.narrative_tone: Warm, slow, respectful, multi-generational; the product is a supporting character, family is the hero
framework.primary_trigger: Nostalgia, tradition and belonging. BioLife is positioned as the quiet, constant presence at the family dastarkhan - the water that is always on the table when the people you love are together.
framework.selection_rationale: Religious period: emotional, respectful framing overrides temperature rules.

guardrails.note: Do not promote ice-cold drinking in freezing weather; message = daily hydration habit and table water for heavy meals.

rules: Never depict eating or drinking during daylight fasting hours
Show water only at suhoor or iftar
Schedule posts after iftar and before suhoor where possible
No music-heavy, party or dance content; calm, respectful tone
No humour about fasting; no discounts framed as 'break the fast early'
Do not quote Quran or hadith in ads without review by a qualified religious advisor

month_context: Late winter, preparation for spring, end-of-winter fatigue

primary_event.emotional_state: Spiritual clarity, patience, gratitude, generosity, family unity at iftar
cultural_rituals: Breaking the fast with dates and water at iftar (iftorlik)
semiotic_symbols: Dates and a glass of water at sunset
primary_event.physiological_state: Daytime fasting (no food or water from suhoor to iftar); dehydration builds through the day; low energy in the afternoon; at iftar the body needs gentle rehydration before heavy food

tone_modifiers: Calm, respectful, family and gratitude; water only at iftar/suhoor
